bootstrapFiles.content:
# Lab prototype (phase 3, Konnectivity). The API server reads this file once, at its start
# (--egress-selector-config-file). The calls of the kind "cluster" go to the proxy server of
# this node over a Unix socket: each call to a kubelet, to a pod, to a Service and to a node
# port. The calls of the kinds "controlplane" and "etcd" stay direct.
# The form is the one of Kubernetes 1.36.4, cluster/gce/gci/configure-helper.sh.
# The socket is in a folder below /etc/kubernetes/policies, because NVKE mounts that folder
# into the API server (read only). The request has no field for a volume.
apiVersion: apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: EgressSelectorConfiguration
egressSelections:
- name: cluster
  connection:
    proxyProtocol: GRPC
    transport:
      uds:
        udsName: /etc/kubernetes/policies/konnectivity/konnectivity-server.socket
- name: controlplane
  connection:
    proxyProtocol: Direct
- name: etcd
  connection:
    proxyProtocol: Direct

# Lab prototype (phase 3, Konnectivity): the proxy server as a static pod of each control
# plane node. The file comes with the bootstrap data of NVKE (controlPlaneConfig.infra.bootstrapFiles).
# The kubelet starts it with the control plane of the node. It needs no scheduler.
#   - the API server of this node talks to it over the Unix socket (gRPC, no certificate),
#   - the agents of the workers dial port 8132 through the shared address,
#   - it shows the agents the certificate of the API server, which has the shared address,
#   - it checks the token of an agent with a TokenReview, through admin.conf (lab shortcut).
# Image: the version that Kubernetes 1.36.4 names for it. It is in the containerd store of
# the node image, so the node pulls nothing.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: konnectivity-server
  namespace: kube-system
  labels:
    component: konnectivity-server
    tier: control-plane
spec:
  hostNetwork: true
  priorityClassName: system-node-critical
  securityContext:
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
  containers:
  - name: konnectivity-server
    image: registry.k8s.io/kas-network-proxy/proxy-server:v0.34.0
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    command:
    - /proxy-server
    - --logtostderr=true
    - --v=2
    - --mode=grpc
    - --uds-name=/etc/kubernetes/policies/konnectivity/konnectivity-server.socket
    - --delete-existing-uds-file=true
    - --server-port=0
    - --agent-port=8132
    - --health-port=8133
    - --admin-port=8134
    - --cluster-cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/apiserver.crt
    - --cluster-key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/apiserver.key
    - --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf
    - --agent-namespace=kube-system
    - --agent-service-account=konnectivity-agent
    - --authentication-audience=system:konnectivity-server
    - --server-count=3
    - --proxy-strategies=destHost,default
    - --keepalive-time=60s
    securityContext:
      # The image runs as user 65532. The key of the API server and admin.conf are files of
      # root with mode 0600, and the API server (root) must connect to the socket.
      runAsUser: 0
      runAsGroup: 0
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      capabilities:
        drop:
        - ALL
    livenessProbe:
      httpGet:
        scheme: HTTP
        host: 127.0.0.1
        port: 8133
        path: /healthz
      initialDelaySeconds: 10
      periodSeconds: 10
      timeoutSeconds: 10
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 25m
        memory: 32Mi
    volumeMounts:
    - name: kubernetes
      mountPath: /etc/kubernetes
      readOnly: true
    - name: konnectivity-uds
      mountPath: /etc/kubernetes/policies/konnectivity
  volumes:
  - name: kubernetes
    hostPath:
      path: /etc/kubernetes
      type: Directory
  - name: konnectivity-uds
    hostPath:
      path: /etc/kubernetes/policies/konnectivity
      type: DirectoryOrCreate

preKubeadmCommands: n=0; until [ -S /run/systemd/private ] || [ $n -ge 600 ]; do n=$((n+1)); sleep 0.2; done; echo "lab wait for systemd: $n steps of 0.2 s"; [ -S /run/systemd/private ]
